card.name: The digit 4 after a leading 4
card.fires_on: A single digit, usually 4 and sometimes 3, that comes right after another 4 inside a multi-digit number. It appears in verse numbers, years, phone codes, counts and decimals.

modes.label: Second digit in 44
modes.description: The digit 4 follows a leading 4 in a chapter or verse reference, a street or law-case name, or a phone code.

modes.label: Digit inside other numbers
modes.description: A digit sits in the middle of a longer number, such as a patient count, a decimal, a year or an ISSN.
